name: Pension-Ferienwohnung Erna
beschreibung: The Pension-Ferienwohnung Erna is located in the village of Thiersee in the Tiroler Unterland. The rural surroundings are characterized by mountains and the nearby Thiersee. The holiday apartment is equipped with a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom, and a traditionally furnished living area. A garden area is available to guests. The quiet, family atmosphere of the accommodation appeals especially to couples and families. Meals are self-catered in the apartment's own kitchen; the village has grocery stores and restaurants.
